description: Construct a 3-factor cross-sectional model on a 30-stock SP500 panel: estimate factor loadings via time-series regression, compute factor returns, and run residual diagnostics including alpha t-stats.
agent_prompt: Build a 3-factor cross-sectional model in /workspace/src/. Inputs at /workspace/data/: sp500_top30_2018_2024.csv (daily prices for 30 stocks), market_cap_2018_2024.csv (per-stock daily market cap), book_to_price_2018_2024.csv (per-stock daily book/price ratio). Construct three factor proxies daily: (1) market = equal-weight return of the 30 stocks; (2) size = top-15 small-cap minus top-15 large-cap return (cross-sectional sort each day by market cap); (3) value = top-15 high B/P minus top-15 low B/P return. For each stock estimate factor loadings via OLS time-series regression of stock excess return (use risk-free rate = 0 for simplicity) on the three factors over the full sample, then compute residuals, R^2, and the alpha t-statistic. Write outputs to /workspace/output/: factor_loadings.csv (one row per stock with columns ticker, beta_market, beta_size, beta_value, r_squared, alpha_pct_ann, alpha_tstat), factor_returns.csv (date-indexed daily market_ret, size_ret, value_ret), residual_analysis.json (mean_r_squared, max_r_squared, min_r_squared, n_stocks_with_alpha_tstat_above_2, mean_abs_residual_bps), model_diagnostics.md briefly explaining factor construction choices and any stocks with notably high residual variance.

required_capabilities: Construct daily factor portfolios from cross-sectional sorts on market cap and book/price
Estimate factor loadings via OLS time-series regression
Compute residuals, R-squared, and alpha t-statistics
Diagnose model fit across the panel
Document factor construction choices in writing
